title: HarnessKit Composite Schema
description: A composite is a first-class, named grouping of canonical components that are installed together. Composites do not introduce a new component kind or adapter output; they expand to their member component ids at install time.

kind.description: Manifest kind discriminator. Always composite for composite manifests.

summary.description: Short description of what this composite groups together

domain.description: Functional domain this composite belongs to. Mirrors the component domain axis.

members.description: Component ids grouped by this composite. Each member must be a registered component id; install-time expansion resolves a composite to this member set.
